reference_sql:
WITH september_spend AS (
  -- one row per channel that spent in September 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id,
         SUM(a.spend) AS total_spend,
         SUM(a.clicks) AS total_clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id
)
SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS spend_eur,
       COALESCE(s.total_clicks, 0) AS clicks,
       ROUND(s.total_spend / NULLIF(s.total_clicks, 0), 2) AS cpc_eur
FROM channels AS ch
LEFT JOIN september_spend AS s ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE ch.channel_group <> 'unpaid'
ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, ch.channel_id

SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(a.spend), 0) AS spend_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(a.clicks), 0) AS clicks,
       ROUND(SUM(a.spend) / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0), 2) AS cpc_eur
FROM channels AS ch
LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.channel_id = ch.channel_id
LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily AS a ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
WHERE ch.channel_group <> 'unpaid'
GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, ch.channel_id

SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name,
       COALESCE(t.total_spend, 0) AS spend_eur,
       COALESCE(t.total_clicks, 0) AS clicks,
       CASE WHEN t.total_clicks > 0 THEN ROUND(t.total_spend / t.total_clicks, 2) END AS cpc_eur
FROM channels AS ch
LEFT JOIN (
  -- one row per channel that spent in September 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS total_spend, SUM(a.clicks) AS total_clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id
) AS t ON t.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE ch.cost_model <> 'none'
ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, ch.channel_id

       ROUND(SUM(a.spend) / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0), 2) AS cpc_eur
FROM channels AS ch
LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.channel_id = ch.channel_id
LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily AS a ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
WHERE ch.channel_group <> 'unpaid'
GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, ch.channel_id
other_way.tradeoff: One grouped LEFT JOIN chain is shorter, but the September filter must sit in the last ON, not in WHERE, or idle channels vanish.

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, SUM(CAST(a.spend AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS spend, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE CAST(a.spend_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id
)
SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(s.spend, 0) AS spend_eur,
  COALESCE(s.clicks, 0) AS clicks,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.clicks, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(s.spend / s.clicks, 2) END AS cpc_eur
FROM channels ch LEFT JOIN s ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE ch.channel_group <> 'unpaid'
ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, ch.channel_id ASC
